Subject: Follow-up + stakeholder map from today's call (ACME Health)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps: 

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference latency for triage workflows, centralize audit logs, and ensure PHI-safe handling for telemetry.
- Primary buying criteria: predictable latency (<300ms p95), SOC 2 evidence, and ability to run in your VPC for PHI.
- Stakeholders you identified today: Priya Shah (CISO) — security questionnaire & architecture sign-off; David Lopez (Procurement) — contracting/payments; Secondary stakeholders: data-platform and ML infra.

Proposed next steps:
1) We kick off the security questionnaire intake — I can send our SOC 2 summary and the questionnaire template.
2) Please share the list of systems you want in-scope for the review (examples: dev, staging, prod, telemetry pipeline).
3) We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with your security & infra owners next week.

I've looped in Vivek to help scope the systems in-scope and Dev for any infra details/answers. Rishi will follow up on commercial / procurement sequencing once we have the scope.

Attachments: ACME_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (you provided during call)

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole

Hi all —

I've reviewed the questionnaire and flagged a few items that will need architecture detail from ACME to answer fully:

- Data flow for telemetry: where logs are sent, retention period, and any PII/PHI fields.
- Authentication: which identity provider (Okta/SAML) and whether service accounts will be used for model inference.
- Network topology: whether outbound connections from the VPC to Redwood are permitted or if a private express connect is required.

Sarah/Priya — can you provide a short diagram (even a screenshot) of your current infra and a list of the exact systems you want in scope (dev, staging, prod + telemetry)? That will let us scope the SOC artifact requests.

Thanks,
Dev
